pain: HOME has no TypeScript workspace, versioned integration contracts or CI, so Activity Events and software-factory messages have no validated shape.
who: Collectors, Projections and software-factory, which exchange Activity Events, Work Requests and Factory Events with HOME.
done_when: At head a430c38dc5846749488ebd73d342824d2a19c52a, npm ci and npm run check pass on Node 22: prettier, eslint, tsc, vitest and build.

specs/integration-contracts holds home.activity-event/v1, home.work-request/v1 and home.factory-event/v1 as JSON Schema 2020-12, and a test checks each schema $id and contract const match its file version.
The Activity Event validator refuses each invalid fixture with the asserted error, including an Event Key prefix that differs from provenance.sourceSystem and an actorKind without actorId.
toWorkPacket output validates against the pinned upstream work_packet.schema.json snapshot, and a tampered snapshot digest makes the test throw.
ci.yml sets permissions contents: read and pins every action to a full commit SHA.
No test is skipped, deleted or loosened.

out_of_scope: Merging, deploying or approving the PR
Paid model spend beyond the approved OpenRouter judge
Any change outside the PR's listed paths

test_command: bash -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run check && npm audit --audit-level=high'

history.reason: Source: commit bc036cf on PR #2, which adds the specs/integration-contracts schemas.
Source: commit bc036cf. The same commit carries the implementation, so GitHub records no separate spec-to-implement time.
